description: This file manages reading, writing, and deleting Telegram update offset state, including validation and path resolution.

methods.name: isValidUpdateId
methods.description: Checks if a value is a non-negative safe integer.

methods.name: normalizeAccountId
methods.description: Normalizes an account ID string by trimming and replacing invalid characters.

methods.name: resolveTelegramUpdateOffsetPath

methods.name: safeParseState
